title: 批准源正常，失败请求走旧地址
premise: 隔离执行器也失败，日志里出现疑似旧依赖端点。
listeningTask: 抓住连通性、授权和下载内容校验的区别。

lines.en: The approved dependency mirror answers normally. Failed requests use a retired address.
lines.zh: 批准的依赖镜像源响应正常。失败请求用了退役地址。

lines.en: Okay, runner health wasn't enough evidence. Just to confirm, approved credentials work?
lines.zh: 好，执行器健康还不够。确认一下，批准的凭据能用？

lines.en: A successful ping won't establish that. Test an authorized fetch with checksums.
lines.zh: ping成功证明不了。用授权下载加校验和测试。

lines.en: That fetch passed on the control. Lockfile hashes match the downloaded packages, right?
lines.zh: 对照下载通过了。锁文件哈希与下载包匹配，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, required package signatures passed too. No fallback to an unapproved public source.
lines.zh: 对，所需包签名也通过。不回退到未经批准的公共源。

lines.en: Let me tail the log again. The old address appears after cache restore.
lines.zh: 我再盯一下日志。旧地址在恢复缓存后出现。

lines.en: Before restore, the configuration points correctly. Keep that sequence with the evidence.
lines.zh: 恢复前配置指向正确地址。把这个顺序和证据一起保留。

lines.en: So, our working hypothesis has narrowed. Something restored overrides the dependency source.
lines.zh: 那么当前假设缩小了。恢复的某个内容覆盖了依赖源。

lines.en: We can rule that out narrowly. Approved-source availability isn't this observed failure.
lines.zh: 可以有限地排除：批准源不可用不是这次观察到的故障。

lines.en: Not every dependency issue, though... agreed. Inspect that cache without deleting evidence.
lines.zh: 但不能排除所有依赖问题……同意。检查缓存，别删证据。
